title: Peformance Team // Recap
summary: Seven-day NC ROAS fell 11% as shoppers held off for Black Friday, so budgets were cut again, Brain down to about 6k to 7k and Thyroid at about 0.42 ROAS with production stopped. The team kept video-first launches, split Blood Pressure into its own campaign at up to 5k, renamed the main campaign Blood Flow and dropped plaque for compliance risk. About 37 Black Friday winner videos get a banner and end card and launch in batches of five to ten into one consolidated campaign.
points: Account NC ROAS down 11% week on week; customers waiting for Black Friday
Videos take most spend over statics; video-first kept
About six ads take roughly 65% of CBO spend across about 200 ads
Neuro, prostate and blood sugar need more creative volume; about 28 neuro and prostate videos a week targeted
Thyroid fell to about 0.42 ROAS; remaining pipeline videos to be tested on the general PDP
One ad spends 22k to 24k a day at 0.45 to 0.48 ROAS
Plaque claims about removing or melting artery plaque seen as a compliance risk
General AVIA campaign launched and is being watched
decisions: Rename the combined campaign Blood Flow and launch a separate Blood Pressure campaign at up to 5k
Stop plaque production and new BP, plaque and blood flow briefs; prioritise neuro, prostate and blood sugar
Stop thyroid production after launching the remaining pipeline
Put all Black Friday winners from every angle in one campaign, launched in batches of five to ten
Test smaller CBOs with about 10 videos at about 2k
Judge the top-spending ad against campaign and account ROAS before cutting it
